newsitem.title: HONG KONG: CITIC Pacific management to buy 15.47 pct stake.
newsitem.headline: CITIC Pacific management to buy 15.47 pct stake.

text.p: CITIC Pacific Ltd said on Monday its management team, headed by chairman Larry Yung, would buy a 15.47 percent stake in the company for HK$33 per share from parent China International Trust & Investment Corp Hong Kong (Holdings) Ltd.

After the transaction, the shareholding of parent CITIC Hong Kong in CITIC Pacific would be reduced to 26.45 percent from about 41.92 percent, the company said in a statement to the Hong Kong stock exchange.

"The transaction has the purpose of serving as an encouragement to the management and also reflects the firm personal commitment of its senior members to the future well being of CITIC Pacific," the statement said.
CITIC Hong Kong is the local investment arm of China's state-owned China International Trust and Investment Corp (CITIC).
The company said CITIC had confirmed that the transaction would not affect its commitment to CITIC Pacific and that it intended to use the proceeds of the deal to fund further projects in China.
CITIC Pacific engages in investment holdings, airline operation, motor distribution and servicing, trading, warehousing and distribution, property investment and telecommunications.
CITIC Pacific shares were up HK$0.70 to a record high of HK$44.30 in early trade on Monday.
